## Profile facts

- AI Consultant, CodrantLabs; technical consulting on project scoping, pricing, initial tech stack, and delivery workflows. Resume date: June 2026. Adithya is represented here as a consultant.
- AI Engineer, Doctreen, Montpellier, France (remote), June 2025-May 2026.
- AI Research Intern, Doctreen (remote), January-June 2025.
- Medical AI work included multi-provider LLM/RAG workflows, DICOM pipelines across 10+ imaging modalities, guardrails, benchmarking, and acting Product Manager responsibilities for proof-of-concept work.
- Implemented an internal serialisation format that reduced LLM token usage by nearly 40%.
- MTech, Computer Science with AI and Machine Learning, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, July 2026-present. This degree is in progress.
- BTech, Computer Science with AI and Machine Learning, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, September 2021-August 2025; CGPA 8.48.
- Research interests: agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM architecture, computational pathology, and medical image analysis.

## Selected work

- [Malabar Coast](https://www.malabarcoast.co.uk/): Live UK restaurant website and operations platform. Adithya worked on ordering with Stripe, reservations, a role-based admin portal with real-time order updates, Sanity CMS, and technical SEO through CodrantLabs.
- [Vidyapath](https://sreyas-vidyapath.vercel.app/): CBSE Class 10 and 12 education software. Public study tools are live; school-management work includes four role-specific portals, assignments, grading, attendance, and multi-model AI routing.
- Mitti Mitra: Native Android prototype combining Gemini vision, Hugging Face image models, Groq, and external APIs for soil and crop guidance. Past scans/results are stored locally; new AI analysis uses connected services.
- Other projects: Namude Yatra (multi-agent travel planner), OptiHire (job application assistant), and Inventory Optimisation using DQN.

## Research

SPARE: Single-view Parameter-efficient Adapter for Radiology Reporting. Accepted at PCCDA 2026 (Springer). Publication is not claimed here.

RAD-DINO vision encoder connected to BioGPT via a semantic alignment adapter, with LoRA fine-tuning for single-view chest X-ray report generation. Reported results: 98% fewer trainable parameters; BERTScore F1 of 79.0 on MIMIC-CXR using 0.8% of training data, reaching 93.6% of MAIRA-2’s score in this evaluation.
